title: California Guard Task Force Supports Wildfire Response
description:
The California Army National Guard's Task Force 49, comprising the 49th Military Police Brigade and other units, is supporting law enforcement officials during wildfire response efforts in the Los Angeles area. The task force’s missions include providing traffic control and security patrols.

Video by Army Sgt. 1st Class Whitney Hughes
keywords: California National Guard, wildfires, california wildfires, CalGuard, DGOV, Defense on Demand
